kiya tum ney ussay dekha jo jaza o saza ko jhutlata hai-?
wohi to hai jo yateem ko dhakkay deta hai .
aur miskeen ko khana denay ki targheeb nahi deta .
phir bari kharabi hai unn namaz parhney walon ki
jo apni namaz say ghaflat barattay hain ,
aur doosron ko mamooli cheez denay say bhi inkar kertay hain .
